citations.quote: The cash flow statement provides information about a company’s cash receipts and cash payments during an accounting period
The cash flow statement has subsections relating specific items to the operating, investing, and financing activities of the company
The cash flow statement tracks operating and investment activities with cash accounting

frontmatter_snapshot.summary: Lays out the cash flow statement's structure under the IFRS / US GAAP framework — operating, investing, and financing classification; direct vs indirect method for the operating section; how IFRS/US GAAP differ on classification choices for interest, dividends, and tax; and how the indirect-method bridge from net income to operating cash flow is constructed.
frontmatter_snapshot.title: Cash Flow Statement Mechanics
